mapper.select: SELECT c.cd_vl AS anls_type_cd, c.cd_nm AS anls_type_nm, c.sort_seq FROM parking.tb_com_cd c WHERE c.group_cd = 'ANLS_TYPE_CD' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parking.tb_anls_vrbl_stng w WHERE w.anls_type_cd = c.cd_vl AND w.expsr_yn = 'Y') ORDER BY c.sort_seq

SELECT w.anls_type_cd, w.anls_trgt_cd, w.vrbl_cd, w.vrbl_nm, w.vrbl_expln, w.vrbl_se_cd, w.stng_vl, w.bsc_stng_vl, w.min_vl, w.max_vl, w.unit_nm, w.use_yn, w.expsr_yn, w.sort_seq, w.mdfcn_dt FROM parking.tb_anls_vrbl_stng w ORDER BY w.anls_type_cd, w.sort_seq

SELECT w.anls_type_cd, w.anls_trgt_cd, w.vrbl_cd, w.vrbl_nm, w.vrbl_expln, w.vrbl_se_cd, w.stng_vl, w.bsc_stng_vl, w.min_vl, w.max_vl, w.unit_nm, w.use_yn, w.expsr_yn, w.sort_seq, w.mdfcn_dt FROM parking.tb_anls_vrbl_stng w WHERE w.anls_type_cd = #{anlsTypeCd} ORDER BY w.sort_seq
